Topics · Death and what comes after

Why would there be a judgment at all?

A life with no reckoning has no purpose. A just balance where no good is lost, and you say what life is for.

Part 1 of 2

﴿أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

Quran · Al-Mu'minun 23:115

The verse turns the question around. It joins two things: being made for nothing, and not being returned. Its thought is that a life with no return and no accounting would have no point beyond itself. The verse asks whether you believe that of yourself. It is a question, and it expects you to answer from what you already think about purpose.

A question for you

Is anything you have made, made for nothing?

If you sayNo, everything I make is for something.
ThenThen the verse asks only that you extend the rule to yourself.
If you saySome things, yes.
ThenIdle things, perhaps. The verse asks whether a being that can ask this question is one of them.

Part 2 of 2

﴿وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed,[887] We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.

Translator's notes

[887] i.e., anything as small or insignificant as a mustard seed.

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:47

Translation

(let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

Original · Hebrew

יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי בְמֹאזְנֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וְיֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי׃

Job · 31:6

World English Bible

﴿فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ٧ وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ٨﴾

Translation of the meaning

So whoever does an atom's weight[1965] of good will see it, And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

Translator's notes

[1965] Or "the weight of a small ant."

Quran · Az-Zalzalah 99:7-8

Translation

For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

Original · Hebrew

כִּ֤י אֶת־כָּל־מַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים יָבִ֥א בְמִשְׁפָּ֖ט עַ֣ל כָּל־נֶעְלָ֑ם אִם־ט֖וֹב וְאִם־רָֽע׃

Ecclesiastes · 12:14

World English Bible

If there is a return, there is a reckoning, and the verse states its terms: a balance that is just, no soul wronged, and nothing too small to be counted. Notice what is brought out: what a person did, down to a mustard seed. The verse names no lineage and no membership. Its standard applies to the one reading it as much as to anyone, and the same book keeps mercy beside the scale (39:53).

A question for you

If every deed were weighed exactly, what would change for you?

If you sayNothing.
ThenThen either you already live as if it were so, or the idea has not yet reached you. Only you can tell which.
If you saySome things.
ThenThose are the things this Step was for.
If you sayA great deal.
ThenThen 39:53 is for you: the door of mercy is kept open in the same book that sets up the scale.

The same in the other books
